g.text: v0.4 — Task checks, prompt tokens and processing time
20 synthetic development fixtures × 3 repeats; repeats share templates and frozen candidates, so are not independent samples.
Configured source-oracle / bounded-code checks; checked mixed can return no valid answer. Local Qwen3 4B target + 8B reviewer.
Content tokens: o200k_base, excluding model wrappers. Timings include real fallback and preparation; no monetary cost was measured.
